title: Abelian combinatorics on words: A survey
exact_topic: Abelian equivalence, abelian complexity, abelian powers and antipowers.
result_relevant: Summarizes known results in abelian combinatorics.
method_relevant: Standard definitions of abelian powers and Parikh vectors.
does_establish: Provides the comprehensive background for abelian combinatorics on words up to 2022.
does_not_establish: Does not establish statistical or variance properties of abelian square-free languages using thermodynamic formalism.

title: Perturbations of Shifts of Finite Type
exact_topic: Changes in topological entropy of an SFT when perturbed by forbidding finite words.
result_relevant: Establishes bounds on the change in entropy when a subshift of finite type is perturbed by forbidding a finite word.
method_relevant: Matrix perturbations and spectral radius changes under word deletion.
does_establish: Foundational bounds for entropy drop under structural perturbations (forbidding words).
does_not_establish: Does not study the asymptotic variance of additive observables (like letter frequency), nor does it classify forbidden words by their Parikh profile.

title: Entropy bounds for multi-word perturbations of subshifts
exact_topic: Entropy perturbation by forbidding a finite set of words.
result_relevant: Establishes a general criterion for upper bounds on entropy difference and proves it tends to zero for certain sequences of word sets.
method_relevant: Generalizes Lind's methods to multiple forbidden words.
does_establish: General bounds for entropy drop when multiple cylinders are deleted.
does_not_establish: Does not address asymptotic variance, Green-Kubo formalisms, or Parikh-composition specific responses.

title: Subshifts of Finite Type with a Hole / Escape Rate with Markov Measure
exact_topic: Escape rates into holes (union of cylinders) for SFTs with Markov measures.
result_relevant: Escape rate depends on the correlation polynomial and overlap structure of the forbidden words.
method_relevant: Relates the spectral radius of the perturbed matrix to the combinatorial structure of the forbidden cylinders.
does_establish: That the combinatorial overlap structure of a hole affects the escape rate (eigenvalue drop) exactly.
does_not_establish: Does not study the variance response of an observable, or relate it to the Parikh profile imbalance of the hole.
follow_up: Literature on linear response for open dynamical systems.
